svg.title: KCD2 recorded camera sequence
svg.desc: Six real frames from the KCD2 demo video laid out as an illustrative camera sequence with an explicit evidence boundary.
svg.text: A Real KCD2 Free-Camera Move from Water to the Castle
Six frames sampled from the 13.4 s recorded demo; this video has no synchronized pose log, so the sequence is illustrative rather than pose-aligned.
The frames are genuine video samples. No claim is made that they correspond to the offline trajectory keyframes or to exact XYZ/yaw/pitch values.
Hybrid vector layout + six raster video frames
